pages.text: $(1)PROGRAM greeting$(br)NOOP$(br)NOOP$(br)FUNCTION greet$(br)  PARAMETER name STRING "World"$(br)  PARAMETER mark CHAR '!'$(br)  RESULT result STRING$(br)BEGIN$(br)  ASSIGN result "Hello, " ⊕ name ⊕ mark ;$(br)END FUNCTION$()

The function joins three parts into one text with $(1)⊕$(). Both parameters have default values, so a caller may leave them out. Called with the name "c0de", the result is "Hello, c0de!".$(br2)To try it, set the trigger block to $(1)greet$(). Put in a STRING variable item named $(1)name$() with your name as its value.
